content.short: CantBeEvil License provides a library of Cant Be Evil License smart contracts managed by A16z for developers to associate their projects with licenses.
content.description: CantBeEvil License provides a library of Cant Be Evil License smart contracts designed for developers who want to attach licensing to their projects. The library supports CC0 1.0 Universal licenses and enables reference to these licenses by exposing the getLicenseName and getLicenseURI methods in NFT projects and other smart contract use cases, allowing retrieval of license name and license URI for associated assets and deployments.
